notes: Read all three units, counterterrorism context, all thirteen candidates and the review. Restored Democratic and partner ownership of rhetoric and tactics, resolved home to the United States and the international scope beyond it, retained evaluative typing for the Trump-era assessment, and tied renewed strategies and tools directly to democratic values in U.S. foreign policy.

claims.claim_text: Democrats believe their own and their counterterrorism partners' rhetoric, policies and tactics must never become terrorist recruiting tools.
Democrats would reject targeting Muslim, Arab and other racial or ethnic communities based on faith or background in the United States or abroad.
Democrats judge that under President Trump the United States too often attacked democracy and human rights and too rarely defended and promoted them.
Democrats believe the fight for universal values should begin in the United States and extend internationally.
Democrats would use renewed strategies and tools to put democratic values at the core of U.S. foreign policy.
